description.id: Makan atau minum sebelum fajar untuk membantu menjalankan puasa.
description.en: Eating or drinking before dawn to support the day's fast.

description.id: Sahur dilakukan mendekati fajar tanpa melewati awal waktu puasa; gunakan jadwal tepercaya setempat.
description.en: Take the pre-dawn meal close to dawn without crossing into fasting time; use a reliable local timetable.

description.id: Berbuka setelah matahari terbenam terkonfirmasi, mengikuti waktu lokal yang tepercaya.
description.en: Break the fast once sunset is confirmed, following a reliable local time.

title.en: Reading and Reflecting on the Qur'an

description.id: Memperbanyak interaksi dengan Al-Qur'an pada bulan ketika Al-Qur'an diturunkan.
description.en: Increase engagement with the Qur'an during the month in which it was sent down.

description.id: Membantu orang yang membutuhkan dan menyediakan makanan secara bertanggung jawab.
description.en: Help people in need and provide food responsibly.

description.id: Menghidupkan malam dengan salat, zikir, dan doa sesuai kemampuan; rincian berjemaah dan jumlah rakaat mengikuti fikih.
description.en: Enliven the night with prayer, remembrance, and supplication as able; congregational details and rak'ah count follow jurisprudence.

description.id: Menjauhi perkataan buruk, pertengkaran, dan tindakan dosa agar tujuan takwa tercermin dalam perilaku.
description.en: Avoid harmful speech, quarrels, and sinful conduct so that the aim of mindfulness is reflected in behavior.

description.id: Meningkatkan ibadah pada malam-malam akhir Ramadan; penentuan malam dan praktik rinci mengikuti panduan fikih tepercaya.
description.en: Increase worship during Ramadan's later nights; identification of the night and detailed practices follow reliable juristic guidance.
